* * *

interface [SwipeRefreshLayout.OnChildScrollUpCallback](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout.OnChildScrollUpCallback)

* * *

Classes that wish to override `[canChildScrollUp](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout#canChildScrollUp\(\))` method behavior should implement this interface.

## Summary

 

### Public functions

`[Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)`

`[canChildScrollUp](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout.OnChildScrollUpCallback#canChildScrollUp\(androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout,android.view.View\))(parent: [SwipeRefreshLayout](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout), child: [View](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/View.html)?)`

Callback that will be called when `[canChildScrollUp](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout#canChildScrollUp\(\))` method is called to allow the implementer to override its behavior.

## Public functions

### canChildScrollUp

fun [canChildScrollUp](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout.OnChildScrollUpCallback#canChildScrollUp\(androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout,android.view.View\))(parent: [SwipeRefreshLayout](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout), child: [View](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/View.html)?): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)

Callback that will be called when `[canChildScrollUp](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout#canChildScrollUp\(\))` method is called to allow the implementer to override its behavior.

 

Parameters

`parent: [SwipeRefreshLayout](/reference/kotlin/androidx/swiperefreshlayout/widget/SwipeRefreshLayout)`

SwipeRefreshLayout that this callback is overriding.

`child: [View](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/View.html)?`

The child view of SwipeRefreshLayout.

 

Returns

`[Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)`

Whether it is possible for the child view of parent layout to scroll up.
